meta.title: Sincere Heart - 5
meta.description: I am not true to myself because I am a Sanctifier, but I am a Sanctifier because I am true to myself.

units.rawText: Why... Why did it all turn out like this...
units.displayText: Why... Why did it all turn out like this...

spans.text: Why... Why did it all turn out like this...

units.rawText: The scene before my eyes eradicates what hope remains inside my heart.
units.displayText: The scene before my eyes eradicates what hope remains inside my heart.

spans.text: The scene before my eyes eradicates what hope remains inside my heart.

units.rawText: All that the Sanctifiers sought to protect had been obliterated. Entropy-infected agent corpses are strewn across the battlefield in a callous mockery of the Sanctifiers' efforts till now.
units.displayText: All that the Sanctifiers sought to protect had been obliterated. Entropy-infected agent corpses are strewn across the battlefield in a callous mockery of the Sanctifiers' efforts till now.

spans.text: All that the Sanctifiers sought to protect had been obliterated. Entropy-infected agent corpses are strewn across the battlefield in a callous mockery of the Sanctifiers' efforts till now.

units.rawText: ...Just what... have I protected...
units.displayText: ...Just what... have I protected...

spans.text: ...Just what... have I protected...

units.rawText: No longer able to support my profoundly wounded body, I crumple to the ground.
units.displayText: No longer able to support my profoundly wounded body, I crumple to the ground.

spans.text: No longer able to support my profoundly wounded body, I crumple to the ground.

units.rawText: <color=red>I told you, didn't I? No matter how hard you try, you cannot protect everyone.</color>
units.displayText: I told you, didn't I? No matter how hard you try, you cannot protect everyone.

spans.text: I told you, didn't I? No matter how hard you try, you cannot protect everyone.

units.rawText: The voice in my heart appears again, working its beguiling magic.
units.displayText: The voice in my heart appears again, working its beguiling magic.

spans.text: The voice in my heart appears again, working its beguiling magic.

units.rawText: <color=red>There is no need for Sanctifiers to risk their lives for these agents.</color>
units.displayText: There is no need for Sanctifiers to risk their lives for these agents.

spans.text: There is no need for Sanctifiers to risk their lives for these agents.

units.rawText: <color=red>Your so-called duty and responsibilities are merely shackles imposed upon us by our creator.</color>
units.displayText: Your so-called duty and responsibilities are merely shackles imposed upon us by our creator.

spans.text: Your so-called duty and responsibilities are merely shackles imposed upon us by our creator.

units.rawText: <color=red>Open your eyes and take in the present... That which you protect is nothing more than data, beings that can be cleared and reset at any time just like you.</color>
units.displayText: Open your eyes and take in the present... That which you protect is nothing more than data, beings that can be cleared and reset at any time just like you.

spans.text: Open your eyes and take in the present... That which you protect is nothing more than data, beings that can be cleared and reset at any time just like you.

units.rawText: I look in the direction the voice points me towards.
units.displayText: I look in the direction the voice points me towards.

spans.text: I look in the direction the voice points me towards.

units.rawText: As if to validate her words, the sector not far away sends out an alert as the gentle light of an impending reset expands outwards from its center.
units.displayText: As if to validate her words, the sector not far away sends out an alert as the gentle light of an impending reset expands outwards from its center.

spans.text: As if to validate her words, the sector not far away sends out an alert as the gentle light of an impending reset expands outwards from its center.

units.rawText: <color=red>They really had to design the light foretelling the end to look like a pristine sunrise.</color>
units.displayText: They really had to design the light foretelling the end to look like a pristine sunrise.

spans.text: They really had to design the light foretelling the end to look like a pristine sunrise.

units.rawText: <color=red>What a terrible sense of humor our creators have... I'm sure you understand now, right?</color>
units.displayText: What a terrible sense of humor our creators have... I'm sure you understand now, right?

spans.text: What a terrible sense of humor our creators have... I'm sure you understand now, right?

units.rawText: Ha... hahaha...
units.displayText: Ha... hahaha...

spans.text: Ha... hahaha...

units.rawText: Anger, despair, sorrow... Inexorable emotions stain my neural cloud.
units.displayText: Anger, despair, sorrow... Inexorable emotions stain my neural cloud.

spans.text: Anger, despair, sorrow... Inexorable emotions stain my neural cloud.

units.rawText: I cannot hold back the laughter any longer. I thump the scorched, listless earth beneath me with a fist until all that I can see is painted red by the bleeding red operands.
units.displayText: I cannot hold back the laughter any longer. I thump the scorched, listless earth beneath me with a fist until all that I can see is painted red by the bleeding red operands.

spans.text: I cannot hold back the laughter any longer. I thump the scorched, listless earth beneath me with a fist until all that I can see is painted red by the bleeding red operands.

units.rawText: <color=red>Yes, like that!</color>
units.displayText: Yes, like that!

spans.text: Yes, like that!

units.rawText: The enticing voice hides its excitement no longer, on the cusp of applauding the scene that is about to play out.
units.displayText: The enticing voice hides its excitement no longer, on the cusp of applauding the scene that is about to play out.

spans.text: The enticing voice hides its excitement no longer, on the cusp of applauding the scene that is about to play out.

units.rawText: <color=red>This is what I wanted to see! The very moment when despair takes hold!</color>
units.displayText: This is what I wanted to see! The very moment when despair takes hold!

spans.text: This is what I wanted to see! The very moment when despair takes hold!

units.rawText: At this moment, a faint cry for help comes from the darkness. I open my eyes, ensuring that what I heard was no illusion.
units.displayText: At this moment, a faint cry for help comes from the darkness. I open my eyes, ensuring that what I heard was no illusion.

spans.text: At this moment, a faint cry for help comes from the darkness. I open my eyes, ensuring that what I heard was no illusion.

units.rawText: <color=orange>H-he... help... me...</color>
units.displayText: H-he... help... me...

spans.text: H-he... help... me...

units.rawText: My body moves before my mind does. After I return to my senses, I am already at the source of the cry for help.
units.displayText: My body moves before my mind does. After I return to my senses, I am already at the source of the cry for help.

spans.text: My body moves before my mind does. After I return to my senses, I am already at the source of the cry for help.

units.rawText: Thank goodness... Someone is still here...
units.displayText: Thank goodness... Someone is still here...

spans.text: Thank goodness... Someone is still here...

units.rawText: A tired and young voice comes from beneath the ruins. I move apart the great rocks, spotting a hand reaching out towards me in the darkness.
units.displayText: A tired and young voice comes from beneath the ruins. I move apart the great rocks, spotting a hand reaching out towards me in the darkness.

spans.text: A tired and young voice comes from beneath the ruins. I move apart the great rocks, spotting a hand reaching out towards me in the darkness.

units.rawText: Huh?!
units.displayText: Huh?!

spans.text: Huh?!

units.rawText: On the pair of hands are a web of purple veins, the signature signs of Entropization.
units.displayText: On the pair of hands are a web of purple veins, the signature signs of Entropization.

spans.text: On the pair of hands are a web of purple veins, the signature signs of Entropization.

units.rawText: I knew this type of Entropization well. It specifically targeted agents and its progress is long and painful, as if it took malicious joy in taking away its victim's vitality bit by bit.
units.displayText: I knew this type of Entropization well. It specifically targeted agents and its progress is long and painful, as if it took malicious joy in taking away its victim's vitality bit by bit.

spans.text: I knew this type of Entropization well. It specifically targeted agents and its progress is long and painful, as if it took malicious joy in taking away its victim's vitality bit by bit.

units.rawText: They may not become monsters at the end of the process, but when the time comes, the host's life is easily stripped away like the corpses that litter the surroundings.
units.displayText: They may not become monsters at the end of the process, but when the time comes, the host's life is easily stripped away like the corpses that litter the surroundings.

spans.text: They may not become monsters at the end of the process, but when the time comes, the host's life is easily stripped away like the corpses that litter the surroundings.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Take my hand, quickly!
units.displayText: Take my hand, quickly!

spans.text: Take my hand, quickly!

units.rawText: I still chose to answer the prayer. I must.
units.displayText: I still chose to answer the prayer. I must.

spans.text: I still chose to answer the prayer. I must.

units.rawText: I-I'm saved...
units.displayText: I-I'm saved...

spans.text: I-I'm saved...

units.rawText: Are you alright?
units.displayText: Are you alright?

spans.text: Are you alright?

units.rawText: I, I'm ok... but the others...
units.displayText: I, I'm ok... but the others...

spans.text: I, I'm ok... but the others...

units.rawText: The little Agent lowers its head, tears welling in its eyes.
units.displayText: The little Agent lowers its head, tears welling in its eyes.

spans.text: The little Agent lowers its head, tears welling in its eyes.

units.rawText: Sorry. If I had been here for a little sooner, maybe I...
units.displayText: Sorry. If I had been here for a little sooner, maybe I...

spans.text: Sorry. If I had been here for a little sooner, maybe I...

units.rawText: <color=red>—You know that wasn't possible.</color>
units.displayText: —You know that wasn't possible.

spans.text: —You know that wasn't possible.

units.rawText: It is as the voice says. I knew that I said these things only to deceive myself, along with everyone else. Excuses so that I may escape from blaming myself.
units.displayText: It is as the voice says. I knew that I said these things only to deceive myself, along with everyone else. Excuses so that I may escape from blaming myself.

spans.text: It is as the voice says. I knew that I said these things only to deceive myself, along with everyone else. Excuses so that I may escape from blaming myself.

units.rawText: But to ease myself, even for a moment, I sought forgiveness by saying it.
units.displayText: But to ease myself, even for a moment, I sought forgiveness by saying it.

spans.text: But to ease myself, even for a moment, I sought forgiveness by saying it.

units.rawText: This isn't your fault.
units.displayText: This isn't your fault.

spans.text: This isn't your fault.

units.rawText: The Entropics attacked so quickly and no one had any time to contact the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: The Entropics attacked so quickly and no one had any time to contact the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: The Entropics attacked so quickly and no one had any time to contact the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: <color=red>—See, your sins have been forgiven as you wished.</color>
units.displayText: —See, your sins have been forgiven as you wished.

spans.text: —See, your sins have been forgiven as you wished.

units.rawText: <color=red>—You should be a bit happier, no?</color>
units.displayText: —You should be a bit happier, no?

spans.text: —You should be a bit happier, no?

units.rawText: <color=red>—Not like she has much time left anyway.</color>
units.displayText: —Not like she has much time left anyway.

spans.text: —Not like she has much time left anyway.

units.rawText: Right, thank you for saving me! I-I want you to have this...
units.displayText: Right, thank you for saving me! I-I want you to have this...

spans.text: Right, thank you for saving me! I-I want you to have this...

units.rawText: Weird, where did I put it...
units.displayText: Weird, where did I put it...

spans.text: Weird, where did I put it...

units.rawText: The Agent rummages for some time, producing a squashed black object from a tattered pocket.
units.displayText: The Agent rummages for some time, producing a squashed black object from a tattered pocket.

spans.text: The Agent rummages for some time, producing a squashed black object from a tattered pocket.

units.rawText: ...This is?
units.displayText: ...This is?

spans.text: ...This is?

units.rawText: This is... chocolate from Burbank.
units.displayText: This is... chocolate from Burbank.

spans.text: This is... chocolate from Burbank.

units.rawText: Hehehe, though it doesn't look any good right now... My friend says that it should be a really, really sweet kind of candy.
units.displayText: Hehehe, though it doesn't look any good right now... My friend says that it should be a really, really sweet kind of candy.

spans.text: Hehehe, though it doesn't look any good right now... My friend says that it should be a really, really sweet kind of candy.

units.rawText: Should?
units.displayText: Should?

spans.text: Should?

units.rawText: Yeah, I've never had chocolate.
units.displayText: Yeah, I've never had chocolate.

spans.text: Yeah, I've never had chocolate.

units.rawText: I wanted to leave this piece for myself... But it's better that you have it as a thank you.
units.displayText: I wanted to leave this piece for myself... But it's better that you have it as a thank you.

spans.text: I wanted to leave this piece for myself... But it's better that you have it as a thank you.

units.rawText: I gave the other piece to another Sanctifier lady. She told me it was sweet and tasty, so I thought you would like it too...
units.displayText: I gave the other piece to another Sanctifier lady. She told me it was sweet and tasty, so I thought you would like it too...

spans.text: I gave the other piece to another Sanctifier lady. She told me it was sweet and tasty, so I thought you would like it too...

units.rawText: She raises her Entropization-covered hand with a laborious effort. She strenuously peels apart the packaging, placing it in my hand with some reluctance, not forgetting to lick the fingers that came into contact with the packaging.
units.displayText: She raises her Entropization-covered hand with a laborious effort. She strenuously peels apart the packaging, placing it in my hand with some reluctance, not forgetting to lick the fingers that came into contact with the packaging.

spans.text: She raises her Entropization-covered hand with a laborious effort. She strenuously peels apart the packaging, placing it in my hand with some reluctance, not forgetting to lick the fingers that came into contact with the packaging.

units.rawText: Have a taste, Big Sis.
units.displayText: Have a taste, Big Sis.

spans.text: Have a taste, Big Sis.

units.rawText: I wished to resist. Unable to deny her willfulness, I can only put the chocolate in my mouth.
units.displayText: I wished to resist. Unable to deny her willfulness, I can only put the chocolate in my mouth.

spans.text: I wished to resist. Unable to deny her willfulness, I can only put the chocolate in my mouth.

units.rawText: How is it?
units.displayText: How is it?

spans.text: How is it?

units.rawText: The taste is not nearly as sugary as expected. Perhaps it was once a fine confectionery, but as of now, only the mixed in taste of gore and bitterness are discernible.
units.displayText: The taste is not nearly as sugary as expected. Perhaps it was once a fine confectionery, but as of now, only the mixed in taste of gore and bitterness are discernible.

spans.text: The taste is not nearly as sugary as expected. Perhaps it was once a fine confectionery, but as of now, only the mixed in taste of gore and bitterness are discernible.

units.rawText: I barely manage to fake a smile and nod for the expectant face in front of me.
units.displayText: I barely manage to fake a smile and nod for the expectant face in front of me.

spans.text: I barely manage to fake a smile and nod for the expectant face in front of me.

units.rawText: ...It doesn't taste good at all, does it?
units.displayText: ...It doesn't taste good at all, does it?

spans.text: ...It doesn't taste good at all, does it?

units.rawText: Ah, that's not true...
units.displayText: Ah, that's not true...

spans.text: Ah, that's not true...

units.rawText: Liar. Big Sis, you're no good at lying, anyone can see what you're thinking on your face.
units.displayText: Liar. Big Sis, you're no good at lying, anyone can see what you're thinking on your face.

spans.text: Liar. Big Sis, you're no good at lying, anyone can see what you're thinking on your face.

units.rawText: Yeah, sorry. All I taste is bitterness.
units.displayText: Yeah, sorry. All I taste is bitterness.

spans.text: Yeah, sorry. All I taste is bitterness.

units.rawText: I see. That puts my mind at ease.
units.displayText: I see. That puts my mind at ease.

spans.text: I see. That puts my mind at ease.

units.rawText: How come?
units.displayText: How come?

spans.text: How come?

units.rawText: Because you're honest, Big Sis. You don't hide what's in your heart with a fake smile, like the other lady.
units.displayText: Because you're honest, Big Sis. You don't hide what's in your heart with a fake smile, like the other lady.

spans.text: Because you're honest, Big Sis. You don't hide what's in your heart with a fake smile, like the other lady.

units.rawText: ...Wait, who's the other lady?
units.displayText: ...Wait, who's the other lady?

spans.text: ...Wait, who's the other lady?

units.rawText: The agent does not respond, only looking towards the sector not far away.
units.displayText: The agent does not respond, only looking towards the sector not far away.

spans.text: The agent does not respond, only looking towards the sector not far away.

units.rawText: It really is beautiful...
units.displayText: It really is beautiful...

spans.text: It really is beautiful...

units.rawText: I follow where she looks.
units.displayText: I follow where she looks.

spans.text: I follow where she looks.

units.rawText: Before I had realized it, the reset's gentle light had already claimed the piled corpses in the warzone, gradually approaching our position.
units.displayText: Before I had realized it, the reset's gentle light had already claimed the piled corpses in the warzone, gradually approaching our position.

spans.text: Before I had realized it, the reset's gentle light had already claimed the piled corpses in the warzone, gradually approaching our position.

units.rawText: Look out! Come over...
units.displayText: Look out! Come over...

spans.text: Look out! Come over...

units.rawText: The words I speak only create an unending silence.
units.displayText: The words I speak only create an unending silence.

spans.text: The words I speak only create an unending silence.

units.rawText: So what if I could save her from the reset? She would have no place to rest in this world, Entropized as she was.
units.displayText: So what if I could save her from the reset? She would have no place to rest in this world, Entropized as she was.

spans.text: So what if I could save her from the reset? She would have no place to rest in this world, Entropized as she was.

units.rawText: But even so, should I simply watch as they are reset and their brief life comes to an end?
units.displayText: But even so, should I simply watch as they are reset and their brief life comes to an end?

spans.text: But even so, should I simply watch as they are reset and their brief life comes to an end?

units.rawText: I knew not the answer. The pair of outreached hands remain suspended in midair, unable to move forward or retreat.
units.displayText: I knew not the answer. The pair of outreached hands remain suspended in midair, unable to move forward or retreat.

spans.text: I knew not the answer. The pair of outreached hands remain suspended in midair, unable to move forward or retreat.

units.rawText: Big Sis, I've already been Entropized... right?
units.displayText: Big Sis, I've already been Entropized... right?

spans.text: Big Sis, I've already been Entropized... right?

units.rawText: I see, of course...
units.displayText: I see, of course...

spans.text: I see, of course...

units.rawText: The little Agent doesn't say much more, accepting their fate nonchalantly.
units.displayText: The little Agent doesn't say much more, accepting their fate nonchalantly.

spans.text: The little Agent doesn't say much more, accepting their fate nonchalantly.

units.rawText: It's okay, Big Sis, don't worry.
units.displayText: It's okay, Big Sis, don't worry.

spans.text: It's okay, Big Sis, don't worry.

units.rawText: Really, I should thank you for chatting with me until the end... This is great.
units.displayText: Really, I should thank you for chatting with me until the end... This is great.

spans.text: Really, I should thank you for chatting with me until the end... This is great.

units.rawText: A smile blossoms upon her face.
units.displayText: A smile blossoms upon her face.

spans.text: A smile blossoms upon her face.

units.rawText: No, no, there's nothing great about this...
units.displayText: No, no, there's nothing great about this...

spans.text: No, no, there's nothing great about this...

units.rawText: I cannot bear it any longer, grabbing the Agent's hand.
units.displayText: I cannot bear it any longer, grabbing the Agent's hand.

spans.text: I cannot bear it any longer, grabbing the Agent's hand.

units.rawText: Go, run, run from this fate. You don't deserve this torment...
units.displayText: Go, run, run from this fate. You don't deserve this torment...

spans.text: Go, run, run from this fate. You don't deserve this torment...

units.rawText: If this continues, you'll be reset by the sector and die!
units.displayText: If this continues, you'll be reset by the sector and die!

spans.text: If this continues, you'll be reset by the sector and die!

units.rawText: Yeah, I know.
units.displayText: Yeah, I know.

spans.text: Yeah, I know.

units.rawText: But if...!
units.displayText: But if...!

spans.text: But if...!

units.rawText: I do not want anyone else to feel this pain.
units.displayText: I do not want anyone else to feel this pain.

spans.text: I do not want anyone else to feel this pain.

units.rawText: The little Agent leans down, gently caressing the soil beneath her feet.
units.displayText: The little Agent leans down, gently caressing the soil beneath her feet.

spans.text: The little Agent leans down, gently caressing the soil beneath her feet.

units.rawText: Big Sis, why did you become a Sanctifier?
units.displayText: Big Sis, why did you become a Sanctifier?

spans.text: Big Sis, why did you become a Sanctifier?

units.rawText: Before I can respond, the reset's light visits us.
units.displayText: Before I can respond, the reset's light visits us.

spans.text: Before I can respond, the reset's light visits us.

units.rawText: Looks like time is up...
units.displayText: Looks like time is up...

spans.text: Looks like time is up...

units.rawText: I knew what she meant to convey.
units.displayText: I knew what she meant to convey.

spans.text: I knew what she meant to convey.

units.rawText: I wanted to say something, but none of it comes out.
units.displayText: I wanted to say something, but none of it comes out.

spans.text: I wanted to say something, but none of it comes out.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Goodbye, Big Sis.</color>
units.displayText: Goodbye, Big Sis.

spans.text: Goodbye, Big Sis.

units.rawText: The Agent takes a half-step back, walking into the sunset that signified the end.
units.displayText: The Agent takes a half-step back, walking into the sunset that signified the end.

spans.text: The Agent takes a half-step back, walking into the sunset that signified the end.

units.rawText: After the gentle light fades, all trace of that which was beautiful or foul had vanished, leaving only the bitterness in my mouth.
units.displayText: After the gentle light fades, all trace of that which was beautiful or foul had vanished, leaving only the bitterness in my mouth.

spans.text: After the gentle light fades, all trace of that which was beautiful or foul had vanished, leaving only the bitterness in my mouth.
